list.title: Site Settings
list.description: Edit contact, social, and other site settings. New keys are added only via the database.

groups.contactDescription: Phone, email, address, and business hours.
groups.headerDescription: Header call-to-action button label, link, and visibility.
groups.seoDescription: Default meta, Open Graph, Twitter, and indexing.
groups.scriptsDescription: HTML / scripts injected into the marketing site <head> and <body> (e.g. analytics, pixels).
groups.corsDescription: Extra browser Origins allowed to call the API (one URL per line). Built-in defaults always stay.
groups.systemDescription: How deleting behaves. Even on permanent, modules that carry history — stock, sales, production — stay recoverable.
groups.financeDescription: Financial defaults such as the VAT rate.
groups.invoiceDescription: Invoice numbering, payment terms and footer text.

form.ctaLabelDescription: Button text per language. Only the languages enabled in Languages are shown.
form.ctaContactPageHint: The header CTA always opens the Contact page (Pages → Contact). Its URL follows that page’s locale slug automatically.
form.seoDefaultsDescription: Fallback title, description, and OG image used when a page has no SEO of its own. Twitter handle, Google verification, and indexing stay site-wide above.
form.updateError: An error occurred while updating settings.
